text: It's a great app. It's very helpful that you can "start" the routine and it tracks your time while you do each habit, and I was really happy to see that you can edit anything the way you want it, e.g. the time you need for each habit. It has great sketches as well. If I could add another feature, it would be the choice to play calming music in the background, or to play a sound every time I complete a habit. But it's great anyway!
